headline: Executive order creates a President's Power Africa Working Group to support efforts to expand electricity access in sub-Saharan Africa.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a working group within the federal government called the President's Power Africa Working Group. The group's role is to help carry out the goals of Power Africa, a US initiative to expand access to electricity in sub-Saharan Africa. No summary was provided, so details on the group's members, duties, and powers are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in Power Africa
who_it_affects.how: They would likely take part in or coordinate through the new working group.

who_it_affects.group: People in sub-Saharan Africa without reliable electricity
who_it_affects.how: The initiative the group supports aims to expand their access to electricity.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 3, 2016; executive orders usually take effect when signed, but the exact date is not confirmed by the provided material.
